model: Each touched viewport cell built a lat:lng string to find its restaurant bucket. The cell is now one integer, latCell * 100000 + lngCell. Earth longitude cells stay inside that stride.

noise.rule: c is the number of touched cells and n is the number of restaurants in the indexed list. 20 is an example, not a live Seoul window. The restaurant index still stores the same buckets. Not a sampled allocator trace.
